summary: Iteration 246 — Monthly Content Goals feature. Backend PUT/GET endpoints and health-tier logic verified via pytest (9/9 effectively pass — the one 'behind' response is correct given server date is July 21, 2026). Frontend end-to-end verified: tab-goals renders SocialGoalsTab, month label 'July 2026', prev/next/refresh present, 4 account cards loaded, edit flow shows all 6 format inputs (reel/carousel/story/feed/photoshoot/live), save persists (0/7 shown after save AND after page reload), goals-row/goals-count with 'Behind' badge and progress bars rendered correctly. Empty state 'No goals set for this account yet. Click Configure to start.' works.

issues: Tab label reads 'Goals' and status badges 'Behind' (English) even though feature was scoped for Spanish user (demo.agency). Consider localizing tab label to 'Metas' and health labels ('Completo/En camino/Atento/Atrasado') based on i18n locale.

action_items: Optional: localize goals tab label + health tier badges to Spanish for ES users.
critical_code_review_comments: _month_bounds: end_prefix uses 'end + T99' string concat for the $lte comparison against scheduled_at. Works because ISO strings sort lexicographically but 'T99' is a non-standard sentinel — safer would be next-day 00:00 or explicit 23:59:59. Not a bug today.
set_monthly_targets: no validation cap on numeric targets (e.g., could store target=999999). Consider clamping to a reasonable max (e.g., 500).
seed_data_creation: Test set/reset monthly_targets on account social_86055792adff via PUT endpoint. Final state after tests: reel=7, carousel=3 (from frontend flow). Main agent may want to reset if this pollutes demo data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Server system date is July 21, 2026 (UTC). This affects health tier for 2026-07 tests: 0/N for any target on current month day 21/31 (~68% expected) will return 'behind' unless actual is close to target. Route is /demand-studio/social-media (not /social). Login button label is 'Continue'.
